orphanProcesses.note: One pre-existing codex.exe process (PID 22032, started 2026-07-11T13:07:47+07:00, before any Gate A probe in this session) was observed; it is not attributable to this diagnostic and was left untouched.

classificationNote: The Windows restricted-token sandbox itself launches and runs a harmless command successfully when invoked directly and unelevated. The recurring failure is therefore not a missing component or a blanket permission/policy block; it is specific to the App Server exec path's 'setup refresh' step and could not be reproduced independently of the App Server in this probe.
nextSafeAction: Rerun the A2.1 approval probe (or a minimal App Server exec probe) capturing App Server stderr around the 'setup refresh' step, and/or compare App Server sandbox configuration (e.g. features/windows sandbox settings in config.toml) against the direct 'codex sandbox windows' invocation — without performing any machine repair or configuration changes.
limitations: Exactly one sandboxed command was attempted per the probe rules; no alternate shells or retries were used.
The App Server 'setup refresh' failure was not re-triggered here, so its root cause is characterized only by the prior runs' failure signature.
codex-windows-sandbox-setup.exe accepts only an encoded payload and was not invoked with one; no setup/refresh/repair was performed.
Process attribution is based on process start times and synchronous completion of the probe command; no descendant-tree supervision was performed (Gate B scope).
